SURFACE_BAD_ANGLE.title: Surface angle out of tolerance
SURFACE_BAD_ANGLE.required_action: Reposition vehicle or select a better contact point before measuring.

SLAM_LOST.title: SLAM lost
SLAM_LOST.required_action: Stop motion. Hover or hold position, await relocalization, or land.

CLPC_STALE.title: Point cloud stale
CLPC_STALE.required_action: Check CLPC publisher, network link, and companion CPU load.

CLST_STALE.title: Status channel stale
CLST_STALE.required_action: Check CLST publisher and network link. Readiness and flight budget are unreliable.

CLPC_LOST.title: Point cloud link lost
CLPC_LOST.required_action: Restart CLPC publisher or restore network before scanning.

CLST_LOST.title: Status link lost
CLST_LOST.required_action: Restore CLST before continuing inspection workflow.
